title: Gap-junction-dependent instructive signals pass from somatic tissue to neoblasts

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Gap-junction-dependent instructive signals pass from somatic tissue to neoblasts

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The authors propose that significant instructive, gap-junction-dependent signaling passes from planarian somatic tissues to neoblasts or their progeny to guide new tissue generation and shaping during regeneration.

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: In this model, we propose that significant instructive (GJ-dependent) signaling occurs from the somatic tissues to the neoblasts or their progeny, to guide the new tissue generation and shaping during regeneration.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Emmons-Bell M, Durant F, Hammelman J, Bessonov N, Volpert V, Morokuma J, Pinet K, Adams DS, Pietak A, Lobo D, Levin M, “Gap Junctional Blockade Stochastically Induces Different Species-Specific Head Anatomies in Genetically Wild-Type Girardia dorotocephala Flatworms”, International journal of molecular sciences (2015), doi:10.3390/ijms161126065; section “3. Discussion › 3.6. Computational Modeling of Head Shape Formation”. Scope: Regenerating planarian heads

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2015-girardia-17: needs-new-data, resolvability 0.43

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The proposed directional mechanism is testable but not established by morphology or model fit. Existing public observations lack the cell-type-resolved perturbation and transfer measurements needed to distinguish it from alternatives.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Selectively block gap-junction signaling in somatic cells, trace candidate signals into neoblasts or progeny, and measure migration and head shape while preserving other compartments. Rescue by restoring the signal would strongly support the mechanism.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Cell-type-specific perturbation and signal tracing are not available in the cited dataset.

The published agent model assumes rather than measures this signaling direction.

fields.value:
data existence: 0.15
analysis feasibility: 0.35
operationalizability: 0.85
discriminating power: 0.75
data adequacy: 0.1

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Direction of an instructive signal from soma to stem cells is a perturbation claim with a shape and stem-cell readout. PlanMine covers planarian gene expression and does not contain this signalling interruption. The proposal stays dependent on new cell-type-resolved experiments.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Interrupt candidate gap-junction-dependent signals from differentiated tissue to neoblasts or their progeny during regeneration and measure whether new tissue shape and neoblast position change while neoblast-intrinsic programs are held fixed. Loss of directed shaping only when that soma-to-neoblast path is blocked would support the proposal.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The instructive signal's molecular identity is left open, so several blocks could be counted as tests.

No public dataset pairs a targeted somatic gap-junction block with neoblast position and final head shape.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:

discriminating power: 0.32

data adequacy: 0.2
data existence: 0.25
